reference: Counts from @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0 in legacy mode with axe-core 4.14.1, options { iframes: false }, only the rules above, Playwright Chromium, locale de-DE, page loaded from a file:// URL with waitUntil load. passes is informational.

color-contrast-fail.html.note: Five texts below the threshold (grey at 2.84:1, #777 at 4.47:1, light on light, 30 % opacity, large text below 3:1); large text and bold 14 pt text at 3.54:1 pass, text on a background image and a symbol-only star rating are incomplete, the disabled button and the hidden paragraph are not counted.

color-contrast-pass.html.note: All visible texts meet 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text), including the borderline grey #767676 at 4.54:1; the low-contrast disabled button and the hidden paragraph are not counted.

image-alt-fail.html.note: Two images without alt, one with alt=" " and one with an empty aria-label are violations; the logo with alt passes and the hidden image without alt is not counted.

image-alt-pass.html.note: Images named by alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby and title, plus decorative alt="" and role="presentation", all pass; images without alt hidden by display:none or aria-hidden are not counted.

label-fail.html.note: Five fields without a name (unlinked text, textarea, checkbox, label for= with a wrong id, empty label); axe accepts the placeholder-only field and ignores the select (rule select-name), type=hidden, submit, reset and the hidden input.

label-pass.html.note: Seven fields named by label for=, wrapping label, aria-label, aria-labelledby and title pass; type=hidden, submit, the button and the hidden input are not counted.

link-name-fail.html.note: Five links without a name (empty, SVG icon, CSS background icon, aria-hidden content only, decorative image with alt=""); the image has alt="" so image-alt passes, the hidden link and the anchor without href are not counted.

link-name-pass.html.note: Six links named by text, image alt, aria-label, visually hidden text, title and aria-labelledby pass; the hidden link and the anchor without href are not counted.

button-name-fail.html.note: Four buttons without a name (empty, SVG icon, aria-hidden content only, hamburger of empty spans); input type=submit and type=button without value and div role=button are outside the rule button-name, the hidden button is not counted.

button-name-pass.html.note: Six buttons named by text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, visually hidden text and image alt pass; input type=submit without value and the hidden button are not counted.

html-has-lang-fail.html.note: The html element has no lang attribute (lang on body does not count), so html-has-lang fails and html-lang-valid does not apply.

html-has-lang-pass.html.note: lang="de" on the html element passes html-has-lang and html-lang-valid.

html-lang-valid-fail.html.note: lang="deutsch" is present but not a valid language code: html-has-lang passes, html-lang-valid fails.

html-lang-valid-pass.html.note: lang="de-DE" (language with region) passes html-lang-valid and html-has-lang.

mixed.html.note: Bakery homepage with 4 contrast errors (one in an open shadow root), 2 images without alt, 1 unlabelled search field, 2 unnamed links and 2 unnamed buttons (one in the shadow root); the display:none mobile menu adds nothing.
